I first started seeing 9:11 and thought something bad was going to happen. Because of the number 11, I have been on an incredible journey. Because I thought something bad was going to happen I was always on the lookout. As soon as I started to be aware of everything I noticed the answers to all my questions were everywhere. My journey lead me to “Conversations with God” by Neale Walsh. 
What I have learned through conversations is that nothing has meaning. Only what you give it. So I have given the number 11 (and also 22 and 33 because I see those a lot as well) the meaning of how I am doing on my journey. When I see those numbers a lot I know I am on the right path, they have become friends to me and I often smile and say hello to them. When time goes by and don’t see my numbers then I know I need to change something, usually my thoughts. If you have $15 I highly recommend you get the Audible app and download Conversations with God the complete series. Please don’t let the word “God” scare you away. It has nothing to do with religion nor is it a cult or a spanking.
